title: Earthy Xeriscape Filipino Mulukhiyah Bicol Express
description: A hearty, earthy, and rich Filipino dish featuring mulukhiyah, a type of leafy green, slow-cooked in a spicy broth with long-fermentation-dough and served in a hot pot vessel.
instructions: Heat oil in a hot pot vessel over medium heat.
Add onion, garlic, and ginger, and sauté until the onion is translucent.
Add chicken breast and pork belly, and cook until browned.
Add mulukhiyah leaves, fish sauce, vinegar, and soy sauce, and stir to combine.
Add 2 cups of water to the hot pot vessel, and bring to a boil.
Reduce heat to low and simmer for 20 minutes.
Meanwhile, cut the long-fermentation-dough into small pieces, and cook in a separate pot of boiling water until they float to the surface.
Drain the cooked dough, and add to the hot pot vessel.
Serve the mulukhiyah Bicol Express in the hot pot vessel, garnished with additional mulukhiyah leaves if desired.
Ensure poultry is cooked to an internal temperature of 74°C / 165°F (juices run clear, no pink remaining) before serving.
